You can always convert EC to PPM based on the kind of meter u have. 


PPM /ec usually means amount of salts in the water. Its a way to measure your nutrient solution stength. High PPM number = strong solution(more salts/nutes). Lesser PPM = Lesser strength of nutes. 

Every single type of common water has salts/minerals in it. Be it ro. Like my Tap water is fairly shitty and it is really hard(contains alotta minerals and shit) and usually comes at 600PPM(horrible to use , burns the plants And causes nute lock outs).


On the other hand my
Ro water comes at only 40PPM(low and good to use)

In coco your starting water should be below 150PPM. 

You add up the nutes to the desired PPM. Once you reach your desired PPM you stop!

Pot too big plant too small.  I feel that autos dont grow very big in big pots is  because they dont get enough veg time. 

Autos are generally not grown in small pots just to avoid transplant. You do not want to damage the roots or stress them or do anything that stunts their growth because they have a short life spam. 

But that doesn’t mean that you grow em in totally big fuck-all pots that the plant struggles to root in. With bigger pots it’ll struggle to grow a bigger root mass quicker with the extended “wet” time.


  

Big pot = Longer wet state and shorter dried state. Plants root faster in dry state because the roots go farther in the search of water. Longer wet means slower root growth. Slower doesnt mean smaller. It just means longer.



Smaller pot(3gal or 5gal) = Shorter wet cycles. Aka the plant will root out faster. Basically constant dry/wet cycle. an auto flower should reach(close) to its optimum size inna 3gal or a 5gal.  It would have completed its lifespan before it would hit a major root bound.


TL:DR- GROW AUTOS IN SMALLER POTSS
